## Entities

### <a id="img-cc-lut"></a>av-cam CC 3D LUT, color matrix and EC gamma

`img.cc-lut` | process

av-cam's CC: 3D LUT (5x9x9 YCbCr), 3x3 Q10 color matrix and EC_Gamma (96 x uint16) applied before 8-bit output.

Aliases: `CC:`, `EC_Gamma`, `5x9x9 YCbCr`, `CC+8`

Current knowledge:

- **C01** `OFFLINE` av-cam.bin applies a CC: 3D LUT (5x9x9 YCbCr), a 3x3 Q10 color matrix and EC_Gamma (96 x uint16) before the 8-bit stage. ([E0505](../evidence/0505-av-cam-cc-3dlut-and-ec-gamma-pipeline.md))
- **C02** `PHYSICAL` Arrivederci applies without a Color Mode round trip because CC+8 is refilled every frame; it uses a matrix fitted to the official ARRI Classic LUT, and an A/B recording test (C0029 on vs C0030 off) verified it live. ([E0555](../evidence/0555-arrivederci-menu-exit-recompute-and-cc8-refill.md), [E0556](../evidence/0556-arrivederci-classic-fitted-matrix.md), [E0610](../evidence/0610-live-a6400-arrivederci-v4-zebra-ab-test.md))
- **C11** `PHYSICAL` A live 4K S-Log3 read-only check captured the CC: RefAdr buffers. ([E0612](../evidence/0612-live-a6400-4k-slog3-cc-refadr-state.md))
- **C16** `INFERENCE` Combining a GPU ARW 2.3 16-byte block unpack + shared-memory RCD demosaic + fused 3x3 matrix kernel, uniform reciprocity log-exposure offsets (preserving 100% roll cache residency), 256 MB pooled Metal / single-VkCommandBuffer batched Vulkan 0.5 MP fused tiles, and selective Float16 exposure/halation/grain storage (keeping LogExposure, Curves, FilmDensity and FilmTiles SATs in Float32) bounds a 36-exposure 24 MP roll within ~198-342 MB dirty memory (~18-38 s projected flagship wall time), while lut_bridge.fit_cube_to_isp fits a 33^3 stock .cube onto BIONZ X's 5x9x9 RefAdr[0] LUT for EVF framing. ([E0505](../evidence/0505-av-cam-cc-3dlut-and-ec-gamma-pipeline.md), [E0689](../evidence/0689-fotufilm-engine-mobile-gpu-film-roll-architecture.md))

([E0601](../evidence/0601-arw-superpixel-2x2-prototype.md), [E0689](../evidence/0689-fotufilm-engine-mobile-gpu-film-roll-architecture.md))

### <a id="img-recording-paths"></a>Open Gate, high-bit-depth and RAW video paths

`img.recording-paths` | process

Feasibility of 3:2 Open Gate, 4K/6K low-fps, 10-bit and RAW/YCC paths, the AIF DMA channel map and the 8-bit ZIMA_AVC ceiling.

Aliases: `Open Gate 3:2`, `ZIMA_AVC`, `AIF`, `SET_RAW_EXTERNAL_OUTPUT`, `rec_fmt_tbl`, `0x63E11750`, `recording-format id`

Current knowledge:

- **C06** `OFFLINE` Open Gate 3:2 recording, 4K/6K low-fps paths and 10-bit / 11-14-bit RAW/YCC video paths were mapped statically and in Unicorn; sabin ZIMA_AVC encoders cap at 8-bit 4:2:0. ([E0578](../evidence/0578-a6400-open-gate-3-2-recording-feasibility.md), [E0620](../evidence/0620-a6400-open-gate-4k-and-6k-paths.md), [E0621](../evidence/0621-a6400-10bit-and-raw-video-paths.md), [E0627](../evidence/0627-a6400-zima-avc-8bit-ceiling.md))
- **C07** `OFFLINE` The AIF DMA channel table and the SET_RAW_EXTERNAL_OUTPUT gate were mapped; AIF0/1 W1/W2 semantics and the RCRAW DDR path decoded; RCRAW line/block calculation verified in Unicorn. ([E0622](../evidence/0622-a6400-aif-dma-channel-map-and-raw-external-gate.md), [E0623](../evidence/0623-a6400-aif-w1-w2-rcraw-registers.md), [E0624](../evidence/0624-a6400-rcraw-calc-unicorn.md))
- **C17** `OFFLINE` In ILCE-6100 av-cam.bin (58b2118d...), RCRAW_EN (0x643EE0F4) and RDRAW_EN (0x643EE4B0) only drive FOPD (0x63777380) and AIF W0/W1 (0x63DC4D94/0x63DC4DA0); AIF0 W2 (0xF3002480 via 0x63DC4DA6 -> 0x63777064) is separately gated by 0x643EDF60 (S_SetFOPD 0x63B483C0 <- 0x6393BDA8 <- SyncGetPrcFlow 0x63B2E80C and DFS 0x6455F1B0 in {2, 3}), and CalcSdevOutSize (0x63DBEFBA) hard-caps SyncGetPrcFlow/Astra output at 640x360, 640x426, or 640x480. ([E9105](../evidence/9105-a6100-rcraw-aif-w2-and-fopd-gates.md))
- **C18** `OFFLINE` av-cam recording-format selection returns an id from the 16-byte sentinel-terminated table at 0x63E11750 (19 entries; (3840,2160) -> id 0, (4096,2160) -> id 1, section word 2 vs 3 -> id 19/20); an unmatched (w,h) writes -1 and the four per-id descriptor copiers at 0x63763D00/0x63763D44/0x63763D60/0x63763D1C then read the record before each table, so editing the table without editing the request key explains the A10/A11 full-screen stride tearing. ([E0729](../evidence/0729-a6400-open-gate-rec-format-id-contract-and-a12.md))
- **C19** `OFFLINE` The userspace size request in libmpr.so transports a picture-size id, not a (w,h) pair: 0x272570 is a (w,h,kind)-to-id table search and RecStartAvcHdContent (0x2B4F6C) stores that id at request+4, while no code in the AviSeqRec region packs a (w,h) pair; av-cam.bin carries 32 (3840,2160) u16 pairs (14 of them in a previously unlisted family at 0x63E369D0..0x63E37C80), and the entry edge of 0x63957ED8 is absent from every static encoding (absolute LE/BE, self-relative, adjacent halves, TBH, BL/BLX/B/ldr+add/ADR/movw-movt). The userspace-to-av-cam segment of the Round-5 graph is therefore not verified, and the premise that userspace sends (3840,2160) over UIPC is refuted as stated. ([E0729](../evidence/0729-a6400-open-gate-rec-format-id-contract-and-a12.md))
- **C20** `OFFLINE` av-cam has a second (w,h)-keyed record walk at 0x639D7E5E (base 0x63E3645C, stride 0x54) that matches [rec+4]/[rec+6] and [rec+0xC]/[rec+0x10] against [obj+0x6EC..0x704] and caches the record at [obj+0x7E8]; it terminates at a 0x16 marker at 0x63E3699C and therefore does not consume the 14-record (3840,2160) family at 0x63E369F0, whose base (like the four vdf_tbl bases) has no reference under 16-bit ldr+add, 32-bit ldr.w literal, movw/movt, absolute u32 LE/BE, self-relative, adjacent u16 halves, TBH, or .data pointer slots. ([E0729](../evidence/0729-a6400-open-gate-rec-format-id-contract-and-a12.md))
- **C21** `PHYSICAL` Live ILCE-6400 Open Gate tests A12-A19 confirm E0729's rec_fmt_tbl contract (A12 restores clean 16:9 with ref=0) and isolate dual-pipe stride behavior: tbl_0x34[0]=6528 alone (A16) yields continuous L/R with horizontal stride lines (ref=157), adding desc_0xAC[0] w[5,7,9]=1684/1728 (A13/A14) yields a clean left half and shifted right half (ref=18/10) because 0x63761C64 (mov.w r4,#3840 -> 1920 right-pipe offset) remained 1920, while desc_0xAC w[38]=1728 (A15/A17) and unaligned 0x03761C64=3240 (1620, A18/A19) halt the pipeline (black screen, ref=16..29); live Movie 4K 24p .bss copies at PA 0x041F1C38 (tbl_0x34) and PA 0x041F2AC8 (desc_0xAC) were captured over TCP. ([E0730](../evidence/0730-a6400-open-gate-a12-to-a19-dual-pipe-live.md))
- **C22** `OFFLINE` av-cam's text logger 0x6394EC5C (6,181 branch sites: 5,630 BL + 551 B.W; 5,597 with a literal format string, 3,975 distinct) emits through 0x6394E4E4 into platform-pool message objects {u16 type, u16 category, u32 level, u32 length, u32 unused, 8-byte timestamp} + payload at +0x18, and keeps a 0x9FF0-byte level-3 duplication budget at 0x64378A10 (PA 0x04378A10, state magic 0x000000B5 at 0x64378A00) with 0x10+len slot accounting and no wrap; no static 0x9FF0 array or absolute pointer to the state exists, so an avlog reader must use the falsifiable exact-termination walk and the 7 always-safe pages (PA 0x04378000/0x0444C000/0x044B0000/0x0434F000/0x04367000/0x045C5000/0x045C6000) that also expose ref=NN at 0x64367AF0 and the noreboot byte at 0x6434FD7E. ([E0731](../evidence/0731-a6400-open-gate-round6-avlog-and-3200-3264-candidates.md))
- **C23** `OFFLINE` 0x63761C58 returns W/2 for rec ids 19/20 only (all three call sites pass selector 1; 0x635D9BB0 is __aeabi_uidivmod), and the value is added to the per-core DMA parameter word +0x14/+0x30 that 0x63762E20 commits to 0xF3851C18/0xF3951C18/0xF3A51C18 through pure setters, with no mask, range or alignment check anywhere; A18 patched both width writers (0x63761C64 and 0x63762F32) to 3240 and was still black, so the unaligned 1620 offset is the only delta from A14, 3200->1600 is 25x64-aligned and 3264->1632 is 32-aligned, and the per-id tbl_0x34 words +0x10/+0x20 (69120) and +0x1C (101888) are width-independent (id 0 stride 7680 and id 1 stride 8192 share them) and must stay stock. ([E0731](../evidence/0731-a6400-open-gate-round6-avlog-and-3200-3264-candidates.md))
- **C24** `OFFLINE` vdf_tbl at 0x63DF199C is statically referenced by 0x6371B764 (16-bit ldr+add pc, literal 0x006D6234) and selected by a class x 1920-threshold map at 0x63CAEADA that returns the same index for 3200/3240/3264/3840, so a width change alters record contents only; ZIMA_AVC (0x63E3B554, 168 x 40 B) is indexed by a caller-supplied index, holds 14 (3840,2160) pairs and a hard-coded 3840x2160 fallback at 0x639DCF9C/0x639DCFA2; DmmConfig.bin is the kernel dmm.ko extent/unit rule table with no w/h/stride field and the sabin/sa_avce_* blobs carry no geometry; ZIMA_SCALER_A/B and dv_venc_initialize() do not exist as statically reachable objects; and libmpr.so emits no pasp/VPRF/hvc1 box, writing tkhd from arguments (0x870738/0x870746) and stsd/avc1 from a descriptor (+0x08/+0x0A -> 0x870A96/0x870A9A) as two independent inputs. ([E0731](../evidence/0731-a6400-open-gate-round6-avlog-and-3200-3264-candidates.md))
- **C25** `OFFLINE` Exact-3:2 FE geometry 5064x3376 (=3376*1.5, versus A5's 4896x3376 = 1.4502:1 Sony mode-15 width) needs exactly seven fields that keep the stock invariants m_left+H+m_right=6024, centre 3004, and 4-pixel Bayer phase: size_rows[16/17] +0x14/+0x1C/+0x24 = 472/5064/488 (VA 0x63E25444/4C/54 and 0x63E25490/98/A0) and rcv_desc mode-16 +0x0C/+0x0E/+0x1E/+0x20 = 484/5064/472/5088 (VA 0x63E1979A/9C/AC/AE); there is no 16/64 alignment law on this path (stock 6024 mod 16 = 8), the tables are initialised data (not .bss) while rt_t14[16] at 0x64201A0C is .bss and re-derived, and a stock FE record still implies W=6000 (+0x24=3004, +0x44+ +0xEC=6024), so patching only size_rows plus rcv_desc is the decisive authority test. ([E0731](../evidence/0731-a6400-open-gate-round6-avlog-and-3200-3264-candidates.md))
- **C26** `OFFLINE` The Movie rear-LCD box is a pattern-selected cell of a 6x9 {f64 x,y,w,h} table at viewUnified2.so VA/file 0x77D090 (group stride 0x120, cell stride 0x20, consumed by 0x2CC9B0 as base+0x120*group+0x20*pattern), whose 16:9 cells are (0,60,640,360) at 0x77D110/150/230/270/470/4B0/590/5D0 and whose stock 3:2 cells are (0,26,640,428); selection is enum-driven (getPanelDisplayPattern 0x2BF8EC returning 0..8, group selector 0x2CC958, aspect getter 0x19D9E0, isPanelAspect16_9 true for enum 2/4) and the movie REC layout family is _169-only, so the only levers are the data edit 60.0->26.0 and 360.0->428.0 (cell bytes +0x0E 4e->3a, +0x1E 76->7a) or the one-byte 0x2BFA3C 04 20 -> 00 20 pattern swap. ([E0731](../evidence/0731-a6400-open-gate-round6-avlog-and-3200-3264-candidates.md))

### <a id="app-android-spektrafilm"></a>CinemaHUD Android SpektraFilm engine (candidate)

`app.android-spektrafilm` | host

Two-tier Android film simulation architecture: live-view 3D .cube preview in android/cinemahud/shaders/monitor.frag plus a candidate 3-pass NDK Vulkan compute engine for developing 36-exposure 24 MP ARW 2.3 rolls via SpektraFilm's spectral-spatial model.

Aliases: `SpektraFilm`, `CinemaHUD Android`, `ARW2 GPU`, `film roll`

Current knowledge:

- **C12** `OFFLINE` Upstream SpektraFilm (3bb2c2d) executes no runtime ODE or PDE solvers, reducing photochemical development to 81-band (380-780 nm) spectral contractions, 1D/2D/3D LUTs, 3-sublayer Poisson-Binomial grain draws and Gaussian/exponential convolutions; Sony ARW 2.3 cRAW (Compression=32767) stores independent 128-bit (16-byte) even/odd row blocks, and CinemaHUD Android already supports 2..65 3D .cube live-view LUT preview in shaders/monitor.frag. ([E0601](../evidence/0601-arw-superpixel-2x2-prototype.md), [E0688](../evidence/0688-android-gpu-spektrafilm-film-roll-architecture.md))
- **C13** `INFERENCE` Replacing desktop spektrafilm-rs's 8-10 full-frame f32 buffers and 162 per-pixel pow loops with a 3-pass NDK Vulkan compute pipeline (GPU uvec4 ARW2 unpack + 64x32 RCD demosaic, RGBA16F mip-pyramid scatter/halation/DIR convolutions, and a once-per-roll 65^3 + 49^3 3D LUT pair) fits a 36-exposure 24 MP roll inside ~323 MB full-frame (~114 MB 4-strip) peak memory on Adreno, Mali and Xclipse GPUs. ([E0688](../evidence/0688-android-gpu-spektrafilm-film-roll-architecture.md))

Related: [av-cam CC 3D LUT, color matrix and EC gamma](#img-cc-lut), [Debayer, dcv_psf / spica and detail stages](#img-detail-psf)

### <a id="app-mobile-fotufilm"></a>Mobile fotufilm-engine GPU darkroom (candidate)

`app.mobile-fotufilm` | host

Apache-2.0 Swift/C++/Halide film simulation architecture (DhaliwalX/fotufilm-engine) for developing 36-exposure 24 MP BIONZ X ARW 2.3 rolls on iOS Metal and Android Vulkan GPUs.

Aliases: `fotufilm-engine`, `fotufilm`, `FotufilmHalide`, `FilmTileMetalBuilder`

Current knowledge:

- **C14** `OFFLINE` DhaliwalX/fotufilm-engine (87a3f46af0, v1.14, Apache-2.0 code + CC BY-SA 4.0 47 stocks) runs no iterative chemical reaction-diffusion PDE solver; it implements closed-form C1 Hermite curves, competitive Hill DIR coupler release with a 3x3 [14, 8, 3] um gap-transmission matrix and decimated Gaussian diffusion, Nelson two-Gaussian screened adjacency, 13.5 MB 17-level Jarvis (exp(-r/1.45 um)) crystal dye-cloud summed-area grain tiles, optional 13-level polarized optical LayeredTransport, and a bundled Sony_ILCE-6400 dual-illuminant 3x3 profile delta (requiring spectralProfileID aliases for ILCE-6100, ILCE-6600, ZV-E10, ILCE-7C, and ILCE-7RM4A). ([E0601](../evidence/0601-arw-superpixel-2x2-prototype.md), [E0689](../evidence/0689-fotufilm-engine-mobile-gpu-film-roll-architecture.md))
- **C15** `OFFLINE` In fotufilm-engine@87a3f46af0 with halide/Halide@58868f0c, iOS Metal develops 24 MP in 0.95 s on iPhone 16 Pro using 60 x 0.4 MP tiles (maximumTilePixels = 512,000, 5.37x faster than 2 MP tiles due to per-stage VM page faults) while leaving FOTUFILM_AOT_WINDOWED_HOST pooling, command-buffer coalescing, and fused GPUShared schedules disabled (0) on iOS; Android Vulkan (FotufilmHalideLinux.cpp; FotufilmHalideAndroidGPU.cpp is unlinkable dead code) issues ~47 separate vkQueueSubmit + vkQueueWaitIdle drains per tile, dereferences raw VkBuffer handles as MemoryRegion* in halide_vulkan_wrap_vk_buffer, omits runtime HL_VK_ALLOC_CONFIG='0:1:0:0:256' Mali uniform padding, defaults to 4.0 MP tiles without halation_fields, falls back to CPU for LibRaw AHD, grain-tile synthesis and LayeredTransport, and rebuilds 13.5 MB grain SAT + 3x33^3 LUT caches whenever per-shot EXIF shutterSeconds shifts reciprocity. ([E0689](../evidence/0689-fotufilm-engine-mobile-gpu-film-roll-architecture.md))
- **C16** `INFERENCE` Combining a GPU ARW 2.3 16-byte block unpack + shared-memory RCD demosaic + fused 3x3 matrix kernel, uniform reciprocity log-exposure offsets (preserving 100% roll cache residency), 256 MB pooled Metal / single-VkCommandBuffer batched Vulkan 0.5 MP fused tiles, and selective Float16 exposure/halation/grain storage (keeping LogExposure, Curves, FilmDensity and FilmTiles SATs in Float32) bounds a 36-exposure 24 MP roll within ~198-342 MB dirty memory (~18-38 s projected flagship wall time), while lut_bridge.fit_cube_to_isp fits a 33^3 stock .cube onto BIONZ X's 5x9x9 RefAdr[0] LUT for EVF framing. ([E0505](../evidence/0505-av-cam-cc-3dlut-and-ec-gamma-pipeline.md), [E0689](../evidence/0689-fotufilm-engine-mobile-gpu-film-roll-architecture.md))

Related: [av-cam CC 3D LUT, color matrix and EC gamma](#img-cc-lut), [Debayer, dcv_psf / spica and detail stages](#img-detail-psf), [CinemaHUD Android SpektraFilm engine (candidate)](#app-android-spektrafilm)
